verdict.rationale: Secureframe has direct evidence of AI extracting answers to security review questions from vendor documents (SOC 2 reports, policies) via Comply AI for vendor risk management, which is adjacent but framed as inbound vendor assessment rather than outbound sales questionnaire response. There's no explicit evidence of a dedicated questionnaire-answering feature drawing from the company's own controls/knowledge base to draft responses to customer-sent security questionnaires, though the Trust Center's document request workflow suggests a related capability. missing for 10: explicit product feature for answering inbound sales security questionnaires from own control data, evidence of draft-and-review workflow for questionnaire responses, sales-lead-specific use case documentation.
